note: 17 unit(s)/citation(s) carry WEAK or absent mapping_strength evidence out of 46 total study units, primarily reflecting (a) MCC's presentation-based objective structure lacking dedicated objectives for several individually-named neurosurgical entities (hydrocephalus, pituitary adenoma, cauda equina syndrome by name, trigeminal neuralgia, craniosynostosis, neurologically determined death) - these are instead captured via targeted search-mcc-objectives calls against the closest broader presentation objectives (headache 39, back pain 50-4, coma 58-1, TBI 109-10) at WEAK/MODERATE strength where a genuine but indirect relationship exists, and (b) several thin pediatric-neurosurgery and specialist-technique study units (craniosynostosis, neonatal IVH, spinal dysraphism, functional/epilepsy/trigeminal-neuralgia surgery, landmark trials) for which no canonical MCC objective evidence was found via the packet's candidate set or search-mcc-objectives, and which are retained as SPECIALIST_DETAIL/REFERENCE_ONLY with minimal coverage weight rather than asserted as DIRECT/COMPONENT without evidence, per project accuracy rules (DIRECT/COMPONENT requires actual MCC evidence; WEAK/UNCERTAIN when evidence is insufficient).
